scope: Pre-rollover additive preparation for ten Week 6 Sunday games after the official NFL schedule reported FINAL. Each pair preserves the exact final, frozen pre-kickoff ratings and H4 identity, final official inactive inventories, literal official in-game injury reporting and precise unreconciled next actions under Week 6 using the actual recording time. All pairs remain BLOCKED pending final gamebook, participation, replacement, interval, cluster and paired numerical reconciliation. Dallas-Green Bay was still live and Washington-San Francisco had not started, so neither is included. This does not advance the active manifest, publish ratings, write current-week personnel/QB overlays, construct fairs or issue a bet.

sources.finding: The official NFL Week 6 schedule reported the ten included games FINAL with these exact scores: CHI 31-ATL 23; BAL 10-CLE 13; TEN 26-IND 20; NYJ 19-NE 26; NO 34-NYG 27; CAR 25-PHI 14; PIT 26-TB 19; ARI 18-LAR 16; LAC 6-KC 22; BUF 33-LV 30. Dallas-Green Bay was live in the first quarter and Washington-San Francisco was scheduled for Monday.

NFL.com published and updated the final inactive inventories for all ten included Sunday games. The exact player lists are preserved per team below; emergency third-quarterback designations are retained literally and are not treated as ordinary injury loss without role review.

NFL.com listed the literal Week 6 in-game injury statuses preserved below. It also reported KC Christian Roland-Wallace and BUF C.J. Gardner-Johnson ejections; those non-injury events are preserved separately and excluded from injury-loss inference.

NFL support says official gamebook PDFs are exposed from final game centers. This preparation has not yet immutably bound and reconciled those gamebooks for the ten newly final games, so participation, exact injury/return intervals and replacement duties remain explicitly open rather than inferred.
